gate4.rationale: The support variant improved all three windows, but incremental positive PnL was too concentrated: max single positive share 0.4281 and HHI 0.3007 breached the Gate 4 concentration guard.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: accepted lagged consensus candidates with prior Companyfacts growth-quality confirmation may deserve modest paper notional support.

2_history_check.exp-20260604-008: Positive replay lead for lagged independent source timing.
2_history_check.exp-20260604-009: Accepted lagged consensus shared default-off adapter.
2_history_check.exp-20260604-011: Rejected cost/liquidity support due incremental concentration.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; before is the current accepted exp-20260604-009 lagged adapter. Accept only if all windows improve with survival, drawdown, concentration, and selectivity guards.

prediction.confidence_reason: Pre-read of exp008 selected trades shows prior Companyfacts confirmation has positive PnL in all three windows and lower rough concentration than the rejected cost/liquidity support, but this is still a nearby support layer on a strong adapter.

preflight.alpha_hypothesis: Accepted lagged free-data consensus candidates with prior Companyfacts growth-quality confirmation may have stronger source-timing quality and deserve a small default-off paper support scalar.
preflight.playbook_alignment: Meta research favors production-visible default-off paper adapters. This tests a source-timing quality field rather than adding a new source family, changing the lagged window, changing source count, or expanding live orders.
preflight.prior_difference: exp-20260604-009 promoted lagged source timing; exp-20260604-011 tested signal-day cost/liquidity support and failed concentration. This run leaves admission and ranking fixed and tests only whether the prior-confirmation family being Companyfacts carries incremental support value.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A retained support result would need the shared free-data consensus adapter to compute the same prior Companyfacts confirmation support in daily production and historical replay, with parity tests, before any report queue, paper ledger, or order surface could change.
